name: Ordinary Tourist eVisa

requirements.blocker_text: Apply via the Tanzania Immigration Department's eVisa portal with a valid passport biodata page, return ticket, a compliant passport-style photo, and the visa fee. Ordinary Visa costs USD 50 (valid up to 90 days); Multiple Entry Visa costs USD 100 (valid 1 year, max 90 consecutive days per visit) and is mandatory for US passport holders in place of the Ordinary Visa. Nationals of EAC member states, most SADC members (except Comoros), and most Commonwealth countries (except the UK, Canada, Nigeria, India, Pakistan, Australia, and New Zealand) are visa-exempt. Nationals of 34 listed countries (including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, Syria, and Yemen) cannot get a visa on arrival without special permission from the Commissioner General, even though ~100+ other nationalities can.
requirements.fix_path: Apply online via visa.immigration.go.tz with passport, return ticket, photo, and fee.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days (Ordinary Visa); 1 year validity with max 90 consecutive days per visit (Multiple Entry Visa)

sources.title: Tanzania Immigration Department eVisa portal -- official guidelines: Ordinary Visa (USD 50, up to 90 days) and Multiple Entry Visa (USD 100, 1 year validity/90 days per visit, mandatory for US nationals), visa-exempt EAC/SADC/Commonwealth categories, and a 34-country visa-on-arrival exclusion list requiring Commissioner General approval
